title: Wingman Completion Tracker
description: Tracked completion checklist for the Wingman platform.

tasks.name: Fix TypeScript compile errors
tasks.description: Resolve all current TypeScript errors blocking a clean build.
tasks.doneCriteria: npm run typecheck returns zero errors.

tasks.name: Fix broken route imports
tasks.description: Correct bad route imports and broken aliases in AppRoutes and related pages.
tasks.doneCriteria: All route imports resolve and no missing module errors remain.

tasks.name: Remove duplicate lazy imports and dynamic import failures
tasks.description: Clean duplicate declarations and lazy-loaded page failures that cause browser crashes.
tasks.doneCriteria: No duplicate identifiers and no failed dynamic module fetches in browser console.

tasks.name: Confirm clean typecheck and build
tasks.description: Validate that both typecheck and production build complete cleanly.
tasks.doneCriteria: npm run typecheck and npm run build both pass.

tasks.name: Stabilise AppShell layout
tasks.description: Ensure AppShell, TopBar, navigation and content grid behave correctly without overflow glitches.
tasks.doneCriteria: Shell renders consistently and no unexpected scroll/overflow issues appear on core pages.

tasks.name: Verify all core pages load
tasks.description: Check Dashboard, Projects, Import, ToolHub, Login, Signup, Landing and NotFound pages.
tasks.doneCriteria: All key pages render without blank screens or runtime errors.

tasks.name: Define one internal page layout standard
tasks.description: Choose the final wrapper, spacing and page-shell pattern for all internal app pages.
tasks.doneCriteria: All internal pages use the same shell and wrapper convention.

tasks.name: Define one public page layout standard
tasks.description: Standardise the layout for public landing, login and signup pages.
tasks.doneCriteria: Public/auth pages share one consistent layout pattern.

tasks.name: Consolidate CSS layers and remove duplicates
tasks.description: Merge duplicate CSS, remove stale rules, and enforce one clear style loading order.
tasks.doneCriteria: No duplicate CSS blocks remain and stylesheet load order is intentional.

tasks.name: Standardise spacing, typography and card scale
tasks.description: Normalize spacing, type scale, panel size and visual density across the app.
tasks.doneCriteria: Common cards and page sections follow one spacing and sizing system.

tasks.name: Finalise Wingman branding rules
tasks.description: Lock logo usage, colour palette, icon style and brand tokens.
tasks.doneCriteria: Brand presentation is consistent across public and internal pages.

tasks.name: Finalise left navigation structure
tasks.description: Set final nav groups, labels and workflow-oriented ordering.
tasks.doneCriteria: Navigation sections are stable, clear and reflect real workflows.

tasks.name: Remove dead and duplicate links
tasks.description: Clean duplicate launch points and links to incomplete or missing pages.
tasks.doneCriteria: Every visible nav item points to a valid working page once.

tasks.name: Define tool tiers and hide unfinished tools
tasks.description: Separate core, advanced and admin/internal tools and hide non-launch items.
tasks.doneCriteria: Only ready tools appear in primary navigation for launch users.

tasks.name: Finalise product schema
tasks.description: Lock the master JSON schema used by product records in Wingman.
tasks.doneCriteria: A single documented schema exists and all records conform to it.

tasks.name: Complete required catalog fields
tasks.description: Populate core fields such as type, role, I/O, connectivity, control, power, resolution and lifecycle.
tasks.doneCriteria: All required fields are present for launch catalogue records.

tasks.name: Add schema validation and bad-import protection
tasks.description: Add validation checks so malformed or incomplete records cannot break the app.
tasks.doneCriteria: Invalid data is flagged before use and import failures are handled safely.

tasks.name: Standardise tags, categories and lifecycle labels
tasks.description: Enforce controlled vocabulary for filtering and consistent output language.
tasks.doneCriteria: Equivalent products use the same tags and category terms throughout the dataset.

tasks.name: Add product browse and search
tasks.description: Allow browsing by family, category and use case, plus search by SKU and product name.
tasks.doneCriteria: Users can reliably locate products through browse or search.

tasks.name: Build product detail pages
tasks.description: Display core specs, ports, power, control, compatibility and lifecycle information.
tasks.doneCriteria: Product detail views are readable and show all launch-critical data points.

tasks.name: Add filters by use case and transport type
tasks.description: Support filtering for AVoIP, matrix, extender, USB/KVM and other solution classes.
tasks.doneCriteria: Filtering narrows results correctly using consistent dataset fields.

tasks.name: Capture room requirements
tasks.description: Collect room type, sources, displays, distance, USB, audio, control and casting requirements.
tasks.doneCriteria: The workflow captures enough inputs to recommend a valid baseline design.

tasks.name: Build recommendation logic
tasks.description: Map user requirements to suitable WyreStorm product classes and solution patterns.
tasks.doneCriteria: RoomWizard produces sensible recommendations grounded in the approved catalog.

tasks.name: Generate system design summary output
tasks.description: Produce a readable recommendation, product stack, caveats and internal handover notes.
tasks.doneCriteria: Output includes a clear design summary and the recommended hardware stack.

tasks.name: Build competitor datasets
tasks.description: Create structured competitor product datasets for Crestron, Extron, Lightware, BluStream and Atlona.
tasks.doneCriteria: Launch competitor brands are represented in a consistent structured format.

tasks.name: Define equivalency rules
tasks.description: Match by product type, I/O profile, transport type, features and control interfaces.
tasks.doneCriteria: Equivalent and partial-equivalent logic is documented and applied consistently.

tasks.name: Build comparison output
tasks.description: Show the nearest WyreStorm alternative with differences, advantages and warning notes.
tasks.doneCriteria: Users receive a clear sales-friendly comparison result for supported competitor SKUs.

tasks.name: Generate BOM from selected design
tasks.description: Build a bill of materials including primary hardware and prompted accessories.
tasks.doneCriteria: Room/design selections generate a reusable BOM list.

tasks.name: Generate proposal and justification text
tasks.description: Output internal and customer-facing summary text explaining the recommended solution.
tasks.doneCriteria: Proposal text is concise, technically safe and usable by sales teams.

tasks.name: Define Guru operating modes
tasks.description: Set the supported modes for recommendation, design help, competitor substitution, BOM help and proposal wording.
tasks.doneCriteria: Guru scope is clearly defined and reflected in prompt logic.

tasks.name: Restrict Guru to approved data only
tasks.description: Ensure responses are grounded in approved structured data and avoid invented SKUs or unsupported claims.
tasks.doneCriteria: Guru only answers from approved sources and flags uncertainty when data is incomplete.

tasks.name: Build guided questioning and fallbacks
tasks.description: Add sensible prompts so less technical sales users can still reach a valid answer.
tasks.doneCriteria: Guru asks useful clarifying questions and provides fallback guidance when data is missing.

tasks.name: Confirm auth flows work
tasks.description: Validate login, signup, email verification and password reset.
tasks.doneCriteria: All required user auth flows complete successfully end-to-end.

tasks.name: Define roles and protected routes
tasks.description: Implement sales, pre-sales and admin access boundaries with route protection.
tasks.doneCriteria: Users only see and access tools appropriate to their role.

tasks.name: Add contextual help and onboarding
tasks.description: Add first-use prompts, definitions and basic page-level guidance.
tasks.doneCriteria: Major tools include enough help for first-time sales users to self-serve.

tasks.name: Create quick-start and role-based guides
tasks.description: Provide simple guides for sales and pre-sales workflows.
tasks.doneCriteria: Users have a concise quick-start path and role-specific usage guidance.

tasks.name: Add data import and update workflow
tasks.description: Create a safe workflow to maintain catalog and competitor records.
tasks.doneCriteria: Admin users can update data without manual code edits.

tasks.name: Add versioning, rollback and health checks
tasks.description: Protect admin changes with history, rollback and health visibility.
tasks.doneCriteria: Bad imports can be detected and reverted without breaking the app.

tasks.name: Test routes and workflows end-to-end
tasks.description: Validate every route and each core business workflow manually.
tasks.doneCriteria: All launch-critical routes and workflows have been tested and signed off.

tasks.name: Test bad inputs, sessions and screen sizes
tasks.description: Check invalid inputs, fresh browser sessions and practical screen sizes.
tasks.doneCriteria: Core workflows remain stable under realistic edge cases.

tasks.name: Create pilot launch package
tasks.description: Prepare known-issues list, launch scope, pilot demo flow and rollback plan.
tasks.doneCriteria: A clear pilot-ready release candidate exists with launch notes and rollback plan.
